category_title: Grade 1 students who resist collaboration and require one-to-one guidance
minimal_context: Kylie is assigned independent math problems to solve at her desk during a Grade 1 mathematics class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please work on the next three math problems independently at your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits at her desk, looking away from the paper and quietly singing to herself instead of starting the math problems.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Kylie, please focus on your assignment and try to solve the first problem.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Quickly writes down a number without showing any work, focused only on the end product, and points to it.) Is this right?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you explain to the class how you figured that out?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Refuses to volunteer her solution or explain her process, looks down, and goes back to playing alone and singing quietly until she is given step-by-step guidance.)
